title: Comment “BRAIN” and I’ll send you the guide to add this to your AI setup 👇 The CEO of Y Combinator
description:
Comment “BRAIN” and I’ll send you the guide to add this to your AI setup 👇

The CEO of Y Combinator just gave away the AI brain that runs his entire operation. For free. On GitHub.

Garry Tan runs the startup machine behind Airbnb, DoorDash, and Reddit, and he put his personal “GBrain” out there for anyone to download. So I installed it.

Some of what’s in there is genuinely INSANE. But here’s the honest part nobody else is saying: this exact setup was built for a billionaire tracking deals, not for normal people.

It quietly costs real money to run, and a free tool already does most of it.

What you actually want are the 2 ideas underneath it:

It links every person, project, and company you mention on its own, so you never organize a thing but it always knows how your whole world fits together.

And every night while you sleep, it cleans itself up and connects the dots. You wake up to a brain that’s a little smarter than you left it.

The tool isn’t the story.

The real story is that a billionaire founder is putting this much effort into an AI second brain, because pretty soon everyone’s going to have one running their life. The people who see that coming are the ones who win.

Don’t have a second brain yet? The same guide has a step-by-step to build one from scratch, free. Just comment BRAIN.

#ai #aitools #secondbrain #aiforbeginners artificialintelligence aiagents
